fato_historico: 2015: A driver deliberately crashes into the Oklahoma State Homecoming parade, killing four people and injuring 34.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite you to reflect on the fragility of life and the immense power of our collective joy. As the stars align, consider cherishing every parade of laughter around you. It is a good time to guard your light, celebrate resilience, and focus your boundless adventurous spirit on spreading warmth and healing kindness to those you encounter along your path.
frase_do_dia: Carry the light within you, for your spirit can heal even the deepest shadows.
significado_numero: Represents the nurturing harmony needed to build a stronger community bond today.
conselho: Choose to walk with gratitude and hold your loved ones a little bit closer.
